summary: A library volunteer urges the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program for public libraries, arguing that cutting or reducing support would harm vulnerable community members who rely on library internet access.

claims.argument: Cutting or reducing E‑Rate support would deprive vulnerable community members of essential internet access, harming their ability to participate in the modern economy.
